digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: mutation test shards historically used stale whole-file mutant counts and must transition from global enforcement to per-shard behavioral evidence gathering with phased promotion modes
advisory mode runs head-only mutation evidence without blocking on survived mutants, timeouts, or no-tests outcomes but blocks on missing or incomplete evidence and execution errors

ratchet mode compares fresh base/head archives and preserves unchanged legacy survivors while blocking killed mutants that disappear or new survivors that emerge in modified functions unless individually fingerprinted as equivalent
strict mode requires every mutant in a shard to be killed or individually reviewed as equivalent and blocks all timeouts, incomplete statuses, and zero-mutant runs

selector detects changed source, test, support files and infrastructure changes via git diff, maps them to shards from the canonical manifest, and derives per-shard matrix jobs with 30-minute limits each

manifest pinned timeout_constant=1.0 and timeout_multiplier=15.0 with per-shard mode declaration replaces repository-level mutmut configuration, and cached mutation verdicts are never reused across workflow runs
